meta.title: Import students
meta.description: Enrol your institution's students in a competition from a spreadsheet.

studentImport.title: Import students
studentImport.lead: Add many students at once: fill in the template, save it as a CSV file and upload it. Every row is checked just like a student added by hand.
studentImport.ages: This competition is for ages {minAge}–{maxAge} on {cutoff}.

template.title: 1. Fill in the template
template.body: One row for each student, in the template's columns. Keep the header row as it is. Columns you add are left out.
template.sample: Or try the sample file, which has a few mistakes on purpose

describe.student_ref: Your institution's roll number for the student
describe.guardian_name: The parent or guardian's full name
describe.guardian_phone: The parent or guardian's Indian mobile number, like 98765 43210
describe.guardian_email: The parent or guardian's email address
describe.student_phone: The student's own Indian mobile number
describe.pin_code: 6 digits. Leave the address, PIN code, city and state empty to use your institution's.

studentImport.limits: Up to {maxRows, number} students and {maxKb, number} KB in one file. In Excel, choose Save As, then “CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)”.

upload.title: 2. Upload the file
upload.label: CSV file
upload.hint: Students already enrolled are never added twice, so you can upload a corrected file again.

result.title: Rows not enrolled
result.downloadHint: The file has these rows as you uploaded them, each with what to fix. Correct them and upload it again.

summary.all: {enrolled, plural, one {# student is} other {All # students are}} enrolled.
summary.some: {enrolled, plural, one {# student is} other {# students are}} enrolled. {notEnrolled, plural, one {# row needs} other {# rows need}} another look.
summary.none: No students were enrolled. {notEnrolled, plural, one {# row needs} other {# rows need}} another look.

studentImport.ignored: These columns aren't in the template, so they were left out: {columns}.

alert.no_file: Choose a CSV file to import.
alert.forbidden: You no longer act for this institution, so nothing changed. Ask its authorised person if that's a mistake.
alert.not_found: We couldn't find that registration. Open it from the competitions page instead.
alert.closed: Registration for this competition has closed, so no students were imported.
alert.not_open_yet: Registration for this competition hasn't opened yet, so no students were imported.
alert.institution_not_verified: Your institution isn't verified at the moment, so no students were imported.
alert.failed: Something went wrong, and no students were imported. Please try again.

file.too_large: That file is over {maxKb, number} KB. Split it into smaller files.
file.not_utf8: That file isn't saved as UTF-8, so names could come out wrong. In Excel, choose Save As, then “CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)”.
file.wrong_separator: That file puts a {separator, select, semicolon {semicolon} other {tab}} between cells. Save it as CSV with commas.
file.malformed: We can't read that file: a quotation mark on line {line} isn't closed properly.
file.missing_columns: That file has no {columns} column. Start from the template.
file.duplicate_columns: That file has the {columns} column more than once.
file.too_many_columns: That file has {columns, number} columns, and one file can have {maxColumns, number} at most. Delete the columns you don't need, or start from the template.
file.no_rows: That file has no students in it, only the header row.
file.too_many_rows: That file has {rows, number} students, and one file can have {maxRows, number} at most. Split it into smaller files.

required.fullName: full_name is empty: enter the student's full name.
required.dateOfBirth: date_of_birth is empty: enter the student's date of birth.
required.guardianName: guardian_name is empty: a student under 18 needs a parent or guardian.
required.guardianRelationship: guardian_relationship is empty: enter parent or legal guardian.
required.guardianPhone: guardian_phone is empty: enter the parent or guardian's mobile number.
required.phone: student_phone is empty: a student 18 or over needs their own mobile number.

problems.too_long: {column}: that's too long. Please shorten it.
problems.invalid_date: {column}: enter a real date, like 2017-06-01 or 01/06/2017.
problems.in_future: {column}: a date of birth can't be in the future.
problems.too_early: {column}: check the year, that date is before 1900.
problems.invalid_format: {column}: a PIN code is 6 digits and doesn't start with 0.
problems.invalid_phone: {column}: enter an Indian mobile number, like 98765 43210.
problems.invalid_email: {column}: enter an email address, like name@example.com.
problems.invalid_characters: {column}: it has a hidden character that can't be saved, often from copying and pasting. Type it again.
problems.outside_age_groups: date_of_birth: this competition is for ages {minAge}–{maxAge} on {cutoff}; this student is {age}.
problems.age_groups_need_fixing: This competition's age groups need fixing by Friends of Animals, so students can't be enrolled yet.
problems.extra_cells: This row has more cells than the header row. Check for a stray comma.
problems.duplicate_in_file: The same student as row {row}, so it was left out.
